craftadvisor.configuration.title: Craft Advisor
craftadvisor.msg.jei_not_ready: JEI is not ready yet. Try again in a moment.
craftadvisor.msg.need_key: No item is named exactly "%s". Use an exact name or id (e.g. minecraft:piston), or set an API key in Mods > Craft Advisor > Config for natural language.
craftadvisor.msg.advice_needs_key: Set an API key in Mods > Craft Advisor > Config to get AI advice.
craftadvisor.msg.clipboard_written: Added %s entries to the clipboard (%s new pages).
craftadvisor.msg.clipboard_truncated: %s entries did not fit on the clipboard.
craftadvisor.msg.clipboard_full: The clipboard has no free pages left.
craftadvisor.ai.bad_key: The API key was rejected. Check it in Mods > Craft Advisor > Config.
craftadvisor.ai.rate_limited: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
craftadvisor.ai.overloaded: The AI service is busy right now. Try again shortly.
craftadvisor.ai.refused: The AI declined to answer this request.
craftadvisor.ai.network: Could not reach the AI API (%s).
craftadvisor.ai.bad_response: The AI's answer could not be read (%s).
craftadvisor.msg.choice_recipe.rule_unus: - %s: no usable %s recipe, used the default choice
craftadvisor.msg.choices_hint: You can change these choices in %s
craftadvisor.msg.rules_bad_line: Skipped line %s of the recipe preferences file: %s
craftadvisor.rules.bad_id: ids need a namespace, e.g. minecraft:spruce_planks
craftadvisor.help.usage: /ai <item or question>: materials, JEI recipe and AI advice
craftadvisor.help.preview: /ai preview <question>: show what would be sent to the AI, without sending
craftadvisor.help.consent: /ai consent: agree to send requests to the AI and continue the held question
craftadvisor.consent.header: AI requests go to %s. Nothing has been sent yet.
craftadvisor.consent.sends: Sent: your question, JEI item candidates, the plan computed by code, and JEI items and recipes the AI looks up.
craftadvisor.consent.sends_inventory: Also sent: an inventory summary (turn off with shareInventory).
craftadvisor.consent.sends_history: Also sent: your recent /ai conversation (turn off with shareHistory).
craftadvisor.consent.not_sent: Never sent: player name, server address, coordinates, chat, renamed item names.
craftadvisor.consent.how: Type /ai consent to agree and continue, or /ai preview <question> to see the exact content first.
craftadvisor.preview.exact_only: Preview: ends with the exact item search. Nothing is sent to the AI.
craftadvisor.preview.tool_results: Only the first request is shown. Tool results depend on what the AI looks up and follow the share settings above.
craftadvisor.help.show: /ai show <item id>: open the JEI recipes of an item (used by the chat links)
craftadvisor.help.add: /ai add <item> [x count]: add a goal to the list (count 1-999 as x4, ×4 or 4개; default 1)
craftadvisor.help.list: /ai list: missing materials of all goals together, counting the inventory once
craftadvisor.help.remove: /ai remove <number>: remove a goal by its number in /ai list
craftadvisor.list.added: Goal list: %s x%s (%s goals). See the total with /ai list.
craftadvisor.list.cleared: The goal list is now empty.
craftadvisor.list.empty: The goal list is empty. Add goals with /ai add <item> [x count].
craftadvisor.list.full: The goal list is full (%s goals). Remove one with /ai remove <number>.
craftadvisor.list.bad_amount: The count must be %s to %s, e.g. x4, ×4 or 4개.
craftadvisor.list.bad_number: There is no goal number "%s". See the numbers with /ai list.
craftadvisor.list.not_found: Could not find a goal item for "%s". Nothing was added.
craftadvisor.offline.no_free_question: Free questions are not available in offline mode. Use an exact item name or id (e.g. create:mechanical_piston).
craftadvisor.offline.similar: No item is named exactly "%s". Similar items (click to show recipes):
craftadvisor.provider.offline: Offline mode: no AI advice. Materials, the JEI recipe and the clipboard still work.
craftadvisor.provider.bad_base_url: baseUrl is not allowed and nothing was sent: it must start with https:// (http:// only for localhost, 127.0.0.1 or ::1). Fix it in config/craftadvisor-client.toml.
craftadvisor.provider.no_model: Set the model name: put your model in "model" in config/craftadvisor-client.toml.
craftadvisor.ai.unsupported: This model does not support tool calls or JSON answers (%s). Materials and the clipboard still work.
craftadvisor.list.searching_more: The name is not exact, so the AI is searching JEI for what you meant: %s
